channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: US Imposes 50% Tariffs on Canada After Trade Talks Fail
item.description: The tariffs take effect early Saturday, following a three-day extension by Trump.

item.title: U.S. to impose 50% tariffs on Canada after talks fail; Canada to retaliate
item.description: The U.S. planned to impose 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian goods early Saturday. Canadian PM Mark Carney said Canada would respond with matching tariffs.

item.title: Lifeguard in Aruba rescues three family members
item.description: A lifeguard in Aruba saved three family members after their tubing trip turned dangerous when one tube collided with a boat.

item.title: Federal government mandates significant Colorado River water cuts for three states
item.description: The cuts are substantial but less severe than the worst-case scenario proposed by the federal government in July.
